sheets.prompt:
Use the SECOND reference character board as a layout and style template and REPLACE ALL FOUR CHARACTERS with the four new HUMAN characters described below, for the fantasy mobile defense game Arcana Guardians.
REFERENCE AUTHORITY: FIRST image's top-row base heroes establish the game's compact head/body proportions and hand-painted fantasy material language. SECOND image establishes the approved 2x2 comparison format and sculpted surfaces. You must NOT copy its tiger, horned smith, animal species, or its exact character identities. This entire new sheet is ONLY HUMAN CHARACTERS.

CRITICAL HUMAN/PROPORTION REQUIREMENTS: all four are adult HUMAN people with human skin, ordinary rounded ears, human hands and feet. Absolutely no beastfolk, elves, dwarves, goblins, horns, tails, wings, animal muzzles or animal heads. Do not let the reference's nonhuman characters leak into this board. Faces differ in age, sex, features, skin tone and hair according to each role. Preserve adult identity and maturity despite the stylization.
All characters are around 2.5 to 3 heads tall from skull top to foot sole, excluding headwear and weapons. Large expressive head occupies roughly a third of body height. Very short neck, compact torso, short thick forearms and shins, large hands and broad boots. This is the SAME approved chunky base-game proportion, not a realistic 6-head figure and not an actual baby. Human women are equally compact and practically dressed.
MATERIAL: rich coordinated jewel teal, ivory, warm brass, ink-blue with role-specific accents. Polished hand-painted three-dimensional fantasy game asset illustration. Rounded/beveled volume, broad color planes, soft warm highlights and clear deeper local shading. Cloth matte broad folds, leather broad stitching and creases, wood few broad grain strokes, steel/copper/gold broad controlled highlights. No photographic pores, gritty noise, countless tiny details, fine filigree, shiny plastic doll finish, flat vector, realistic long limbs or modern firearms. Faces, hands and key tool/weapon silhouettes must remain separate and clear. Distinguish hero/mercenary/NPC/common soldier via actual equipment simplicity, not changing the core art style.

COMPOSITION: high-quality square board, exactly FOUR equal panels in a 2x2 grid, one full-body human per panel. Pale warm parchment background, fine muted gold dividers. Same scale, full-body 3/4 angle, subtle view from above, neutral readable ready or occupational pose, small soft contact shadow. Every head, tool, weapon, banner and foot fully within panel with generous margins. No environment scenery, pedestal, interface or written prose. Only simple black A in upper-left panel, B in upper-right panel, C in lower-left panel, D in lower-right panel. No other text. Do not add a fifth figure.

BOARD 11 — DISTINCTIVE HUMAN HEROES AND LEADERS. Highest but still controlled equipment detail; one iconic silhouette per hero, coordinated Arcana teal/ivory/brass accents.
A TOP LEFT: adult human woman gate captain, dark warm brown skin, huge determined expressive face, short black braided hair swept to one side, compact ivory-steel plate armor with warm bronze edging, short teal commander cape, oversized broad arming sword and shield with a single tree crest. Firm upright command pose, rounded human ears.
B TOP RIGHT: elderly HUMAN male rune sage, large wise face with a prominent nose, strong gray brows, short swept-back white hair and trimmed white beard, compact deep-indigo robe over ivory tunic, wide teal belt, one oversized brass rune-ring staff with a cyan crystal; broad open hand shows a small simple rune. No wizard hat covering his face, no long beard dwarf look.
C BOTTOM LEFT: adult East Asian HUMAN male wandering swordsman, huge expressive angular face, black hair tied in a short topknot, compact athletic body, short ink-blue and ivory lamellar travel coat, vermilion waist knot, one oversized slightly curved sword with a chunky brass guard held visibly beside his body, simple sword scabbard and big wrapped boots. Original fantasy traveler rather than existing hero duplication.
D BOTTOM RIGHT: adult HUMAN woman desert relic tracker with tan skin, very large expressive face, thick dark eyebrows and brown braid, saffron hood pushed back, teal scarf and compact sand-colored leather armor, brass goggles on forehead, chunky ancient-relic crossbow with one turquoise inset, small map tube at hip. Confident adventurous expression.
